protocol.required_attestation_statement: September reference residuals and post-burn outcomes never inspected
protocol.calendar_rule: First complete calendar month between the existing August and October benchmark windows
protocol.primary_event_population: Every published event whose start lies in the month, including detector misses and unavailable outcomes
protocol.set_selection: Earliest epoch strictly after published burn end; no residual-dependent replacement
protocol.endpoint_definition: Truth-minus-SGP4 signed in-track position residual in reconstructed-orbit RIC at set epoch plus 96 hours
protocol.primary_score: Mean absolute prediction error versus zero prediction on the same finite calibrated pairs, with full event and unavailable counts
protocol.additional_burns: Retain in primary; flag all additional records through endpoint, including those before the first-set epoch
sensitivity_plan: leave one burn out for primary
leave one element set out for secondary
termination_rules: passes through the longest tested lead
scope_limits: September GP and weather previously entered October fits
Late September orbit product overlap was cached
No local September residual evaluation found; outside-repository inspection requires author attestation
protocol.execution_resume: Explicit resume=True only; identical protocol/source/attestation, frozen GP, verified saved truth and completion hashes; original access marker and every attempt retained
protocol.publication_status: Review required before deposit; no deposition authorised by execution

record.statement: September reference residuals and post-burn outcomes never inspected
record.author: Nikhil Bhana
record.author_verbatim: I have never inspected September 2024 reference residuals or post-burn outcomes outside this repository, in any tool or session. Record that in the protocol and run the experiment.
record.recorded_from: Explicit author message in this Codex task

local_evidence.finding: No prior September residual evaluation was found in the bounded local audit; this is combined with the author statement about inspection outside the repository.

record.prior_exposure_qualification: September GP and weather informed earlier October fits; late-September orbit-product overlap was cached. The claim concerns reference residuals and post-burn outcomes, not all inputs.
